title: Savory Chinese Frittata
description: A rich and savory twist on the traditional frittata, infused with the bold flavors of Chinese cuisine.

ingredients.name: velvety
ingredients.notes: Soy sauce or other velvety sauce of choice

ingredients.name: iodine
ingredients.notes: Sea salt or other iodine-rich seasoning

ingredients.name: portuguese
ingredients.notes: Dried oregano or other Portuguese seasoning

ingredients.name: rich
ingredients.notes: Olive oil or other rich oil

instructions: Whisk eggs in a large bowl and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together velvety sauce, iodine seasoning, and Portuguese seasoning. Add to eggs and whisk until combined.
Heat rich oil in a 9-inch oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Pour in eggs and cook until edges start to set, about 2-3 minutes.
Transfer skillet to oven and bake for 15-20 minutes or until eggs are set.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Slice into wedges and serve hot.
